_comment: Zed → hosted OmniMind MCP. Merge `context_servers` into Zed's settings.json (Zed → Settings → Open Settings). Zed sends the static Authorization header on every request and does not surface MCP elicitation, so destructive tools (memory_supersede, memory_consolidate with dryRun=false) rely on their server-side confirm/dryRun arguments — prefer a read-mostly token here. Token: BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools. Put 'Start with status_get; log decisions with decision_log' in the assistant's default prompt for the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8).
